narrative.northStar: Stay Cinema + Reception Desk (guest) · Concierge phone-sheet (ops)
narrative.overview:
MOJO ships two visual systems that share brand hues but never share costume. The public guest site is Stay Cinema + Reception Desk: a full-bleed hero film, centered brand, dark floating reception desk, sheet-cream nav, royal CTAs, gold as hairline emphasis, Bricolage Grotesque + Source Sans 3, and alternating editorial property plates. The internal `/admin` console is Concierge phone-sheet: a dense ops rail, enquiry queue beside a request folio, system-UI type, and paper-flat work surfaces.

Guest density is editorial and calm; ops density is triage-first. Both refuse purple marketing themes, multi-layer glow shadows, and Instant Book theater.
keyCharacteristics: Guest: full-bleed hero video; paper ground #F7F5F2 + sheet-cream nav chrome; Bricolage + Source Sans 3
Guest: royal CTAs; gold on brand lockup, plate/menu hairlines, and link underlines — not fill buttons
Guest: alternating editorial plates (image|copy / copy|image); dark floating reception desk on the hero
Ops: paper stone + cream sheet + white panels; system UI; 13px dense rows
Ops: royal actions; gold only on NEW status chips; queue beside folio

rules.name: The Gold Hairline Rule (guest)
rules.body: Gold accents brand lockup, plate dividers, menu hairlines, and link underlines — never button fills or decorative icon washes.

rules.name: The Gold Urgency Rule (ops)
rules.body: Gold appears only on NEW status chips. Every other ops accent is royal or lavender.

rules.name: The No Metric-Card Rule (ops)
rules.body: Counts live in hairline-divided strips or tab badges — never elevated SaaS stat cards.

rules.name: The Two-Stack Rule
rules.body: Guest = Bricolage + Source Sans 3. Ops = system UI only. Never cross-pollinate display faces into /admin or revive Inter on guest Stay Cinema chrome.

rules.name: The Workhorse Type Rule (ops)
rules.body: Admin uses the system UI stack and ~13px dense body. No serif display or marketing faces in the ops shell.

rules.name: The Cinema First Rule (guest)
rules.body: Hero video is edge-to-edge plane; do not inset it in cards, side panels, or rounded media frames.

rules.name: The Queue-Beside-Folio Rule (ops)
rules.body: Triage never replaces the list with a full-page detail. Selection = royal left hairline + lavender wash; folio updates in place.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer borders and paper layers over shadow. No multi-layer drop shadows or glows on either surface.

dos: Do keep guest first viewport as cinema + brand + one line + CTAs + reception desk — no marketplace clutter.
Do use Bricolage for guest display/title/plate and Source Sans 3 for guest body/UI.
Do use royal for primary actions on both surfaces; apply gold per surface rule (hairline guest / NEW-only ops).
Do keep Enquiries as queue + folio side by side.
Do set ops type to the system UI stack at ~13px dense.
Do separate surfaces with brand-ink/10 hairlines on paper grounds and sheet cream.
Do say Request to Book (honest launch language), not Instant Book.
donts: Don't inset the hero video in cards, side panels, or rounded media frames.
Don't use gold as a guest CTA fill or as ops chrome decoration outside NEW chips.
Don't build SaaS metric-card dashboards inside /admin.
Don't introduce rounded-full pills or multi-layer glow shadows on Stay Cinema or ops controls.
Don't open enquiry detail as a full-page takeover that hides the queue.
Don't invent testimonials, ratings, or occupancy claims on guest surfaces.
